title: Path normalization strips meaningful leading dots
reasoning: str.lstrip('./') removes any sequence of dots and slashes rather than a literal './' prefix. Requests for .config/settings.json become config/settings.json, and hidden-file glob patterns are similarly changed. Collection silently omits the requested files or returns a different file.
reproduction: Create .config/settings.json and config/settings.json with different contents, then request .config/settings.json. The non-hidden file is selected.
recommendation: Remove only explicit current-directory prefixes while preserving hidden path components and glob syntax.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Included collection tests cover ordinary names and nested paths but no leading-dot filenames or directories.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend literal and glob collection tests with hidden paths, optional './' prefixes, and similarly named non-hidden files.
